concept: DR strategies: pilot light — core always running
tests: Recognizing pilot light: only a minimal core (the DB) runs continuously in the DR region.
expected: Pilot light — core services (DB with replication) always running; the rest is spun up on failover. Triggers: "minimal version of core services runs continuously", "rest scaled up only during failover".
why_not: Backup and restore — nothing running; active-active — full capacity everywhere; cold standby with no resources — not pilot light.
